propositions: Cancelled GitHub Actions runs on main appear as red X's on healthy commits, degrading signal fidelity.
Option 3 (schedule-only health checks every 6 hours) eliminates cancellations by removing the push trigger for main entirely.

Main health reporting must emit a copy-pasteable git bisect recipe with bisect-run commands to last-known-green SHA on RED runs, and publish the green SHA on SUCCESS runs, to enable rapid remediation of multi-commit regressions.
Last-known-green SHA resolution via Actions API (GH_TOKEN with actions:read scope) must degrade gracefully to a placeholder with explanation if the lookup fails, never turning a green main red.

Six workflows require disposition review (test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml, codeql.yml, terraform-drift.yml); gerrit-verify.yaml, reconcilers, external-integration.yml, and reusables remain unchanged.

Non-main branch push CI must be preserved; main must be added to branches-ignore on four workflows; two workflows must drop push entirely; all six must gain workflow_dispatch; external-integration.yml stays weekly.
